[[File:Nightfall screenshot 14.jpg|thumb|300px|The [[Abyssal]], a Nightmare creature]] The [[Shadow Army]] is the main coalition that opposes [[Balthazar]]'s [[Eternal]]s. They are the forces of [[Menzies]], Balthazar's half brother, and the army is staged in the never-ending plane of [[Ravenheart Gloom]].
